name: Ferienwohnung Kofler
beschreibung:
Sunnily situated in Ebbs, Ferienwohnung Kofler provides pleasant living space for families and couples, featuring bright rooms and mountain vistas.

The Fohlenhof stud farm, the Kaiser valley ascent, and the Hallo du leisure centre are all reachable in minutes.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Kofler in Ebbs offers family comfort at the foot of the Kaiser mountains in Kufsteinerland.
